name: outlook-crm-addin
description: An Outlook taskpane add-in that logs the open email to a CRM: matches the sender (or recipients, in compose) against contacts, shows a context card, and offers log / follow-up / task with a warn-but-allow duplicate check. Public rebuild of an internal tool: the CRM is a fictional dataset in the pane, so the manifest can be sideloaded straight from GitHub Pages with no server.
